description: Stack Overflow for Teams connector (read-only). Surfaces the team's private Q&A `questions` as `stackoverflow:question` items in the local index — the title, the question body, the tags, the score / view count / answer count, the answered flag, and the asking user. Useful for answering knowledge questions ("how do we handle retries?", "who knows about the billing pipeline?") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer API-token auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` — a Stack Overflow for Teams Personal Access Token; never logged) plus the `Accept: application/json` request header. The SaaS host (api.stackoverflowteams.com) is fixed; the team slug is URL-encoded into the request path. The v3 API page-paginates the `/v3/teams/<team>/questions` endpoint by page number (1-based, page_size=100), returning the `{ items, totalCount, pageSize, page, totalPages, sort, order }` envelope. `creationDate` / `lastActivityDate` / `lastEditDate` are ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). `webUrl` is the per-question canonical URL. Answers, articles, tags-as-items, and users-as-items are deferred follow-ups; v1 indexes questions only.
author: Nimbus
